Bonus afterstory (Fallen Eclair reinject Arcana with Shadow's power)
Arcana returns → Cure Eclair falls to become a dark Pretty Cure → Arcana becomes her victim.

Bonus afterstory 2 (Arcana Rod & Doggy Luluka)
・Arcana Dildo
An Arcana Rod that was corrupted by the dark powers of Iften-Ka. It was remodeled after Luluka’s mind and body were tainted by dark powers.

Tentacles grow from the petal-like ends which fuse with the user’s womb upon entry. When the user reaches a sexual climax, a concentration of dark power will be released inside the user’s womb in a semen-like form.

Works as a more efficient method of corrupting Precures as the womb is more vulnerable to dark powers.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
Bonus afterstory 3 (The transfer students, Howa & Moria)
Two female transfer students from Makoto Mirai Academy were reported to have allegedly restrained a male student. The young man was then forced to witness the female students engage in a threesome with an unidentified middle-aged man.
Such victims may risk getting caught and implanted with a “Demakoto Jewel.” Those found with these jewels often risked turning into an “Akunnida,” a monster that poses as a danger to other civilians and even Precures…

・Nega-Kit Rouge
A mutated version of the pre-kit Gloss.
Upon applying to one’s lips, their outfit will transform to be more suitable in fulfilling one’s sexual desires.
To people other than Iften-Ka, their outfit may appear normal, but their disguise can be unveiled at will.
